crossRefs.note: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.
For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right…
to him who struck great kings; for his loving kindness endures forever;

translations.web: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings,
translations.bsb: He struck down many nations and slaughtered mighty kings:
translations.kjv: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;
translations.asv: Who smote many nations, And slew mighty kings,
